| YOY:gaap_operating_income_loss | loss_widened | -1307 | n/a | exact_from_selected_facts |

Sources:
- baseline: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1647639/000164763924000032/upst991prq22024.htm (SHA-256 212f471f0522e46f10d405ed96658aa5b3c211ef86a3b6fe8d2db30e55b93e13)
- event: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1647639/000164763924000045/upst991prq32024.htm (SHA-256 a86e6ffcd9520f35c8dba80b439b7a8ff21eae5ba90d3afe22bd62d1173a4b45)

Referenced calculations: SEQ:gaap_total_revenue, SEQ:gaap_operating_income_loss, SEQ:gaap_net_income_loss, SEQ:contribution_profit_non_gaap, SEQ:adjusted_ebitda_non_gaap, SEQ:adjusted_net_income_loss_non_gaap, YOY:gaap_operating_income_loss, YOY:adjusted_net_income_loss_non_gaap.

Research implication: The sequential packet supports a research read that UPST's core lending economics improved quarter over quarter, since GAAP revenue rose while GAAP operating loss narrowed and non-GAAP contribution profit and adjusted EBITDA both moved up, which is consistent with the thesis catalysts of business growth and earnings quality rather than with the stated invalidation of weakening demand.

Counterpoint: The strongest contrary input is the year-over-year basis, where GAAP operating loss and non-GAAP adjusted net loss both widened versus the prior-year same quarter, and the GAAP net loss narrowing is accompanied by a nonoperating gain on debt extinguishment large enough to exceed the entire GAAP net loss, so the favorable net-loss move cannot be read as operating improvement and no stored source reconciliation quantifies any driver-to-metric bridge.

Evidence to seek: What would change the assessment is the full filing and earnings materials for the same quarter, showing the reconciliation of GAAP to non-GAAP measures, the composition and recurrence of the debt extinguishment gain, and segment or revenue-line detail that explains whether the sequential revenue and contribution improvement is durable rather than a one-quarter mix effect.

Decision: maintain; causal status: observation_only.
Source scope: selected, verified exhibit facts; not a full-filing review.
